fusions.name: Find the Lady
fusions.desc: Flicks out 3 cards at once, spread apart. Each card deals 3 damage, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet and a 20% chance to turn it against its allies for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: The Long Con
fusions.desc: A thrown blade that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one used.

fusions.name: Come and Catch Me
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Already Fooled
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
